text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heya-hey, Trainer! Wanna try<n>something like a
part-time job?
choice_data_list: Like a part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The manager of the ramen<n>shop I work at is
running a survey to<n>improve customer satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My manager said the more feedback<n>we get, the
better, so I got tasked<n>with bringing you along!

...Or so she thinks. The truth is, we<n>needed a
cover-up to get Ines Fujin<n>to the ramen shop.

And that's because... her friends and<n>the
convenience store manager are<n>lying in wait there,
ready to kick off<n>her surprise party!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but if you already have plans,<n>don't worry
about it! I was just<n>asking in case you were free.
choice_data_list: No, I'm more than happy to come along.
No, I'm more than happy to come along.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey, Boss! It's your favorite<n>customer, Ines—

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager, Palmer, & Helios
text_block_list.text: Seat for one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, what are you all doing?<n>And you're in
on it too, Boss?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And you messed up the numbers!<n>Trainer's here
too, so you should<n>have said "two—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, when did you get changed,<n>Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Please take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha? What's this all about?!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I now present to you your first dish.<n>This highly
nutritious salad was<n>curated in part by yours truly.
Don't<n>worry, I'll send you the recipe later.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wow, it looks so cute and<n>delicious! I think
even my sisters<n>would eat this...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Next up... We have some sashimi foryou. This dish has been approved byone of our veteran part-timers!You're going to love it, Fu.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It looks amazing! And it's low<n>on fat while
still being filling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And here's your drink delivery... Anenergizing juice for all yourflyer-distributing needs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... the manager said they can't<n>make it today
'cause of work, but<n>they wanted you to enjoy this
in-development sports drink!
choice_data_list: And then, for dessert...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The name of this dish is "Running<n>Fam!" 'Cause
we're down to run<n>with you whenever and
wherever! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Amazing! I have no notes! But...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I am extremely confused right now!
choice_data_list: Well, that's understandable.
Well, that's understandable.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Okay. The truth is, I lied about the<n>customer
satisfaction survey.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: R-really?! So what's going on here?
choice_data_list:
This is an expression of gratitude from your
managers.

This is an expression of gratitude from your
managers.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Grati...tude?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Fu, thanks for all you do. Your<n>cheerful attitude
towards work has<n>been such a boon to this place.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerfulness and proactive work<n>ethic have
been a help so many<n>times.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we wanted to repay<n>you for
everything you've done.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You guys... I should be the onerepaying the favor here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But still, I want to make the most of<n>your kind
gesture!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Time to savor every last crumb of this<n>goodwill
gourmet course!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Mmf... Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! What a meal! The food was so<n>delicious—mild
and sweet, just how I<n>like it!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it! So, what did you<n>think? I hope you
enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This one's a no-brainer! A gesture<n>like this,
arranged by all the people I<n>love...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: As if it could be anything but amazing!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: What a relief!
choice_data_list: Looks like we hit it out of the park!
Looks like we hit it out of the park!
Sorry for keeping this all a secret!
Sorry for keeping this all a secret!
I'm starting to see why you feel the way you do.

text_block_list.text: What a relief!
choice_data_list: Looks like we hit it out of the park!

Sorry for keeping this all a secret!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was one impressive<n>surprise—annoyingly
so! You really<n>got me good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But surprises really are awesome! I<n>want to get
another one sometime.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Which means I've got to keep doing<n>my best—with
my races, work,<n>everything! ♪

Smiles spread across everyone's<n>faces, and our
show of gratitude for<n>Ines Fujin ends up an
enormous<n>success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not even mad... Wait, did you<n>want me to
be?
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I mean, you did fib to me. Okay, as<n>punishment...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm signing you all up for a goodwillgesture from me next time! ♪

We all join in with the lighthearted<n>banter, and our
show of gratitude for<n>Ines Fujin ends up a
success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The way I feel? What does that<n>mean?
choice_data_list: Why you feel happy making people happy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Oh, really?

I come to understand exactly how<n>Ines Fujin feels,
and our show of<n>gratitude for her ends up a
success.
